nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set to 'Tether USD' in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to 'USDT' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, set to 6.
Total token supply state variable, initialized to 100000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor that sets metadata, mints the entire supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; performs raw subtraction.
View function returning the balance of a given token owner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to', debiting the caller's allowance, using safeSub/safeAdd.
Pure helper performing checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Pure helper performing checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a).
Pure helper performing checked multiplication c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure helper performing checked division c = a / b with require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used for minting, approvals, allowance debits and balance debits.
Raw arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath, potential underflow.
State write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without zero-allowance race protection.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) state write.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) state write.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) state write.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) state write.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) state write.
Arithmetic c = a + b followed by require(c >= a) overflow check.
Arithmetic c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) underflow check.
Arithmetic c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply minting write performed in the constructor.
Address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf used as mapping key.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance used as first mapping key.
Address parameter spender of allowance used as second mapping key.
Address parameter spender of approve used as mapping key.
uint parameter tokens of approve written into the allowance mapping.
Address parameter to of transfer used as recipient mapping key.
uint parameter tokens of transfer used in safeSub/safeAdd balance adjustments.
Address parameter from of transferFrom used for balance and allowance debits.
Address parameter to of transferFrom used as recipient mapping key.
uint parameter tokens of transferFrom used in safeSub/safeAdd operations.
uint parameter a of safeAdd used in the addition.
uint parameter b of safeAdd used in the addition.
uint parameter a of safeSub used in the subtraction.
uint parameter b of safeSub used in the subtraction and the require(b <= a) check.
uint parameter a of safeMul used in the multiplication.
uint parameter b of safeMul used in the multiplication.
uint parameter a of safeDiv used as the numerator.
uint parameter b of safeDiv used as the denominator and require(b > 0) check.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of allowance.
Named return variable success of approve, always set to true.
Named return variable success of transfer, always set to true.
Named return variable success of transferFrom, always set to true.
Named return variable c holding the safeAdd result.
Named return variable c holding the safeSub result.
Named return variable c holding the safeMul result.
Named return variable c holding the safeDiv result.
